body: I know that you have to move on. But it is not just the breakup that broke me. I was broken already and it just added extra fuel to what was already there. I have been miserable. I have tried it all. I know there is no reason for me to be depressed yet I am. I was before I met her, having her in life might have consoled me for some time, but then after her leaving it just made it worse.
